fact_sheet.business_description: Precision Castparts manufactures complex metal components, investment castings, forgings, and critical fasteners for aerospace and other demanding industrial applications [D01]. These components are essential for safe operation in aircraft and industrial programs, with supplier replacement made difficult by stringent certification and reliability requirements [D01].
products_customers_and_why_they_buy: Investment castings, forgings, and critical fasteners [D01].
Sole or dominant source on many engine/airframe programs; long-term agreements support repeat business [D09].
economics: Operating margins have consistently exceeded 20% since FY2007 [D09].
Returns on tangible capital are above 20% [D09].
Requires maintenance investment and is sensitive to inventory and material costs [D01, D05].
FCF was approximately $1.9 billion in FY2015 [D09].
earnings_record: Cyclicality noted in energy-related, pipe businesses, and aerospace destocking [D09].
competitive_position: Sole or dominant source on many programs; process expertise and certification form a moat [D01, D09].
Management (Mark Donegan) is regarded as the industry's best operator [D09].
Peers include Honeywell, United Technologies, and Allegheny Technologies [D04, D06].
balance_sheet_and_capital_needs: High capital intensity not required, but backlog can move with production schedules [D01, D09].
management_and_capital_allocation: Mark Donegan, CEO since 2002; would remain to run the business [D09].
Regarded as honest and an excellent operator [D09].
what_the_market_is_worried_about: Aerospace customer concentration and bargaining power [D01, D05].
Weakness in energy-related and pipe businesses [D09].
Risk of paying peak earnings as normal [D05].
deal_terms_if_any: Proposed acquisition of 100% of shares at ~$235/share (premium of 20% over market price) [D09].
Mark Donegan to remain as CEO [D09].
berkshire_context: Berkshire cash at 2014 year-end: $63.3bn [D08]; potentially $66.6bn at time of proposal [D09].
missing_data: Maintenance capex estimate to calculate normalized owner earnings [D01, D04].

understandable.evidence: Precision Castparts provides essential, certified metal components for aerospace and industrial programs where high switching costs and reliability requirements create long-term stability [D01].

durable_moat_and_pricing_power.evidence: The company holds sole or dominant source status on critical engine and airframe programs, protected by stringent certification barriers [D01, D09].

consistent_earnings_record.evidence: Sales and net income have grown consistently from 2011 to 2015, with operating margins maintained above 20% since 2007 [D02, D09].

high_roe_little_debt.evidence: Returns on tangible capital are consistently above 20%, and the company maintains a manageable debt profile relative to its earnings power [D09].

capital_intensity.evidence: While maintenance investment is required, the business generates significant free cash flow and delivers returns on capital that justify its industrial scale [D01, D09].

able_honest_owner_minded_management.evidence: CEO Mark Donegan is recognized as an industry-leading operator with a strong reputation for honesty and effective management [D09].

size_moves_the_needle.evidence: The proposed acquisition of Precision Castparts represents an 'elephant' size transaction suitable for Berkshire's capital allocation [D09].

price_screen.evidence: The acquisition at roughly 22x trailing earnings provides an acceptable return given the high quality of the business and the current low interest rate environment (2.18% 10-year Treasury) [D04, D09].

gate1.one_line_business_quality_verdict: a high-moat aerospace and industrial components manufacturer with excellent returns on capital and a top-tier management team.

gate2.why_available: The market is fixated on short-term cyclical headwinds in the energy-related pipe business and temporary destocking trends in the aerospace sector [D09]. This creates an opportunity for Berkshire to acquire a permanent, high-moat business with an elite operator at a fair price [D09]. We view the long-term compounding potential of Precision Castparts' sole-source components as far outweighing current earnings volatility [D01, D09].

The aerospace and industrial programs remain dependent on these critical, certified components

gate3.price_vs_value: 111% of low-end value; limited margin of safety at $235 premium price
gate3.alternatives: Existing holdings or Berkshire buyback; while the business is wonderful, the 22x P/E is full, but acceptable for a permanent elephant-sized, high-moat utility-like aerospace supplier [D09]
gate3.downside_case: Permanent loss unlikely due to sole-source status and mission-critical nature of products, though cyclicality may impair near-term cash flows [D01, D09]
flagged_assumptions: Maintenance capex assumed equal to depreciation for owner earnings calculation [D01, D04]

gate4.role_description: We intend to acquire 100% of the business, leaving the management team in place to continue operating the company with our backing, as Mark Donegan is an exceptional operator whose style aligns with our own [D09].
value_realisation_path: Value is realised through the continued compounding of the business's earnings, leveraging its dominant sole-source market position and the retention of its existing management team [D09].
gate4.why_this_role_fits_the_era: In the 2000-2015 era, our strategy focuses on acquiring whole companies at scale to provide a permanent home for our capital and float, particularly those with durable competitive advantages [D09].

kill_criteria: Aerospace and engine manufacturers shift to alternative manufacturing processes that bypass Precision Castparts' proprietary techniques
Stringent aerospace safety certifications are altered or diminished, allowing for lower-cost, lower-reliability substitutes
Mark Donegan departs or management culture shifts to prioritize financial engineering over operational excellence
Long-term aircraft demand enters a secular, multi-year decline rather than a cyclical adjustment
gate5.berkshire_constraints: Must maintain cash above $30 billion floor post-acquisition [D08, D09].
gate5.opportunity_cost: Comparison between acquiring a permanent, high-moat industrial asset versus holding cash or repurchasing Berkshire shares at current valuation levels [D09].
gate5.decider_reason: As a whole-company 'elephant' acquisition within our circle of competence, this capital allocation decision is made by Buffett [D09].
gate5.biggest_risk_in_one_sentence: Paying peak-cycle earnings for a capital-intensive manufacturing business that remains susceptible to cyclical aerospace and energy demand shocks.

valuation.downside_case: Cyclical earnings volatility due to energy and aerospace destocking [D09]

drivers.driver: The acquisition at ~$235/share represents a 22x trailing earnings multiple, which provides a fair entry point for a permanent, high-moat business when compared to the 2.18% 10-year Treasury yield [D04, D09].
Precision Castparts acts as a sole or dominant source for critical metal components where stringent safety certifications create an enduring moat against competitors [D01, D09].
The company has maintained operating margins above 20% and returns on tangible capital exceeding 20% since 2007, reflecting exceptional underlying economics [D09].
Mark Donegan is an elite operator who will remain at the helm, ensuring the business continues to be run with the honesty and capital discipline we demand [D09].
The market's current fixation on cyclical energy headwinds and aerospace destocking allows us to acquire a wonderful business at a fair price [D09].

final.what_would_change_our_mind: A fundamental shift in the aerospace industry where proprietary investment casting and forging processes lose their mission-critical status, or a departure of management that signals a decline in operational excellence.
final.memo:
Charlie and I have long admired Precision Castparts, a company that produces essential components for aerospace and industrial programs where reliability is paramount [D01, D09]. We understand the business well: by providing sole-source, certified parts, they have embedded themselves into the long-term success of the world's most critical engine and airframe manufacturers [D01, D09].

The economics of this business are first-rate. Precision Castparts has consistently maintained operating margins above 20% and returns on tangible capital exceeding 20% since 2007, proving the durability of their moat [D09]. The certification barriers required for their components act as a formidable fence, protecting their market position from lower-cost substitutes [D01, D09].

Mark Donegan, who will remain as CEO, is an exceptional operator whose integrity and management style perfectly align with our values [D09]. We are happy to back a team that has a proven, multi-year record of operational excellence and capital discipline [D09].

Currently, Mr. Market is preoccupied with temporary aerospace destocking and cyclical weakness in the energy-related pipe business [D09]. This misperception allows us to acquire a high-moat, elephant-sized business at a fair price [D09]. While the 22x earnings multiple at $235 per share is not 'cheap' in the traditional sense, it represents a fair price for a permanent utility-like supplier of critical parts when compared to current low interest rates [D04, D09].

We anticipate this investment to serve as a cornerstone of our industrial holdings for decades to come. Our primary risks involve cyclical demand shocks or a shift in manufacturing technology, but given the company's sole-source status, we believe the risk of permanent capital loss is remote [D01, D09].
